swapTest: 5/5 pass (Alert title+description+action+close, Inline notice description+close, Toast title+description+progress, Progress label+value+track padding, Empty state title+secondaryAction)
anatomy: Alert: M3 banner. radius/card 28, no stroke; subtle = <tone>/subtle (neutral surface/container-high); strong = badge/solid/<tone>/bg + badge/solid/<tone>/fg (important strong primary/default + primary/fg: no important/default role), rule hidden; glyph size/icon/sm in the label line; action Tonal/Button / sm ghost (text); close Tonal/Icon button / xs.
Inline notice: status-chip language. radius/badge 8, no stroke, <tone>/subtle (neutral container-high).

Toast: M3 snackbar on the ladder. Literal radius 20 (menus), no stroke, effect/shadow float, status <tone>/subtle, default/loading container-high, ghost action; timer a 4px inset pill + theme-only timer-gap (visible bound to progress).

Progress: T.wave. Track transparent and clipped; base bar kept hidden; theme-only wave frame (wave-clip + wave-line in <tone>/text, rest and rest-start text/muted lines 4px off the wave, constraint-pinned) and a stop dot; value still = track padding; stroke 3/4/6, track 8/12/16.
Progress circular: arc <tone>/text, round caps, ring surface/container-highest.
Skeleton: surface/container-highest bones, pill lines, circle avatars, 16 blocks (lg radius/card).

Skeleton preset: table = segmented rows (surface/container, table/row-gap, table/row-radius inner, 28 outer), no head or rules; other presets tonal containers r28 without strokes; bones Tonal/Skeleton.

Empty state: border on = surface/container card (radius/card) instead of the dashed rule; media 14/12 squircle (first-use primary/container, no-results container-highest, error destructive/subtle); Tonal/Button / md filled + ghost.

sweep.detail: Data display 1: 67 Skeleton + 2 Empty state (Tonal/Table, Tonal/Data table loading/empty); Overlays: 2 Spinner
sweep.tableBadgeTones: Tonal/Table rows keep distinct tones (success, warning, info, success, neutral): not affected by the 2026-10-31 row-tone defect

defectsFixed: Tonal/Field hid labels for Switch/Radio/Slider/OTP/Checkbox: the label instance is now visible in the vertical variants (its 'text' part materialises again, so base label overrides carry over); the nested Tonal/Input hides field-label and its padding is re-centred 24/8 -> 16/16. Fields now show the label above the filled field.

Tonal/Field control lost part names: in the Tonal screens the swapped controls were named after their component (Select, Textarea, Slider, Switch, Radio group, Input OTP, Checkbox): 16 layers renamed back to 'control' (Tonal style sets were already correct).

Tonal Sidebar nav items lost part names: 19 icon layers named 'Icon/<glyph>' renamed back to 'nav-icon' (Tonal/Nav group 12, Tonal/Sidebar 3) and 'glyph' (Tonal/Sidebar toggle 4). Collapsed Nav item parts match the base (no marker in base collapsed).

fixes: Field labels: 6 duplicate inner field-labels hidden (+12 in the first pass), controls re-centred
Orders sheet: Email and Tracking number rows hidden so the pinned overlay fits (560 of 696; same as the Tactile and Terminal groups)

ownerReview: Alert strong light uses the Badge solid pairs: info and success white-on-step-9 are ~3.3:1 / 3.0:1 for body text (below 4.5:1), the same known trade-off as Badge solid.

Tonal/Field now puts the label above the filled field (the M3 label-inside look survives only on standalone Tonal/Input) - the only way every control keeps its label and base label overrides survive the swap.
notTouched: Data display 1 review/strip PNGs were not re-shot after the Skeleton/Empty state sweep.
